notes.title: Demo release
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

The demo version of [b]Vox Populi: Canada 2025[/b] is now available! It allows you to play as a candidate in the Ottawa municipal election within a simplified scenario.

You can also preview the scenarios, ideologies, and flags of the full version of the game, which will be released very soon.

Please report any bugs or problems. Enjoy the game!
